description: One status line when a session starts: commits behind, branches to prune, dependency pull requests and Dependabot alerts. Each kind of problem, such as a failed fetch or a missing git, gets a line of its own. Fetches, but never changes a branch, worktree, or working tree.

hooks.command: if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{"systemMessage":"\\ngh: ⚠️ node not found on PATH"}\n'; exit 0; fi; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook-io.ts" session-start; exit 0
